description: Water leaking or flooding from pipes, including burst pipes, leaking joints, and water supply line failures. May involve ceiling leaks, wall leaks, or floor flooding.
Water intrusion from the roof due to damaged roofing material, flashing, or drainage issues. Often triggered by heavy rain or snow.
Clogged, running, or malfunctioning toilets, urinals, and restroom plumbing fixtures.
Partial or complete loss of electrical power in a building, floor, or suite. May affect lighting, outlets, and equipment.
Flickering, burned out, or malfunctioning light fixtures including fluorescent tubes, LEDs, and ballasts.
Exposed wiring, sparking outlets, burning smell from electrical panels, or other dangerous electrical conditions.
Air conditioning system not producing cold air, blowing warm air, or complete AC unit failure.
Heating system not producing warm air, boiler or furnace failure, especially critical in winter months.
Poor air quality, strange odors from HVAC system, inadequate ventilation, or mold concerns related to HVAC.
People trapped inside an elevator that has stopped between floors. Always treated as an emergency.
Elevator not operating correctly but no one is trapped. Includes doors not closing, skipping floors, unusual noises.
Doors not closing, latching, or locking properly. Includes automatic doors, fire doors, and suite entry doors.
Shattered, cracked, or broken glass in doors, windows, or partitions. May be a security or safety concern.
Key card readers not working, locks broken, access denied incorrectly, or security badge issues.
Suspected gas leak, chemical spill, or hazardous material release. Always treated as an emergency requiring evacuation.
Active fire, smoke, or fire alarm activation. Includes sprinkler system activation.
Wet floors, uneven surfaces, damaged walkways, ice, or other conditions that could cause falls.
Empty soap dispensers, paper towels, toilet paper, or general restroom cleanliness issues.
Stains, spills, or general carpet and floor cleaning needs. Includes steam cleaning requests.
Reports of insects, rodents, birds, or other pests in or around the building.
Potholes, damaged signage, broken fencing, lighting outages in parking areas, or exterior structural damage.
